template: Relocation assistance and LAHD filing for no-fault evictions under the RSO and JCO applies to this address. Source: LAMC 151.09.A.8-14, 165.03.H-M, 165.06, 151.30, 47.06-47.07; RAC Regulations 960.00; as of 2026-10-01. Not legal advice.
rewrite: For this address, the rules on relocation assistance and on filing with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) apply to no-fault evictions (evictions not caused by the tenant) under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) and the Just Cause Ordinance (JCO). Source: LAMC 151.09.A.8-14, 165.03.H-M, 165.06, 151.30, 47.06-47.07; RAC Regulations 960.00; as of 2026-10-01. Not legal advice.
